snippet.title: Vacation Simulator - Launch Trailer - Owlchemy Labs
snippet.description:
Book your vacation now on SteamVR, Oculus Rift, PlayStation VR, or Oculus Quest!

Rediscover the true meaning of TIME OFF! Welcome to the Vacation Simulator: a rough approximation of VACATION inspired by real human NOT JOBBING, brought to you by the same robots behind the Job Simulator. Reallocate your bandwidth and get ready to splash, s’more, snowball, and selfie your way to optimal relaxation!

Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/726830/Vacation_Simulator/
Oculus Rift: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1818689078164305/
Oculus Quest: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/2393300320759737/
PlayStation Game Page: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/vacation-simulator-ps4/

Vacation Simulator Website: https://www.vacationsimulatorgame.com
